public_rationale: Meta publicly released downloadable Llama 3 models on April 18, 2024. That directly supports the ordinary reading that LLM technology was already available outside its developers’ control by the post date. The evidence establishes availability, not every implication of the Pandora’s Box metaphor.
limitations: Public availability does not establish the scale of malicious use or prove that all safeguards can be defeated.
The claim supplies no numerical deployment threshold.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: The Pandora's Box of LLMs has already been opened.

statement.excerpt: I shared some of my own thoughts about which Pandora’s Boxes had (LLMs) and had not (AGI) already been opened.

our_interpretation: The ordinary reading is that LLM technology had escaped exclusive developer control through public release and distribution, making misuse possible.
The metaphor does not establish that every feared harm had happened or that safeguards were ineffective.
‘Already’ describes releases occurring on or before the post. The target period therefore has no specified starting date.
criteria.support_condition: Dated records show that LLMs were publicly accessible and model weights were available for download before May 17, 2024.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Records establish that LLMs remained restricted to controlled research settings, without public access or distribution, through May 17, 2024.
